definitions.explanation: Indicates likelihood or probability. Suggests the speaker thinks something is likely but isn't certain.

examples.japanese: たぶん⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦でしょう→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧。
たぶん⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
たぶん⟦{来|こ}ない→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I don't think they'll probably come.

examples.japanese: 「{田中|たなか}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来|き}ます→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。」「たぶん⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦わかりません→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。」
examples.english: "Will Tanaka-san come?" "I think they'll probably come, but I'm not sure."

examples.japanese: たぶん⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦でしょう→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧。⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦どおり→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧です⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧。
examples.english: The train was probably delayed. They're usually someone who arrives on time.

notes:
たぶん expresses probability (roughly 60-70% certainty). Can be written as {多分|たぶん}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- たぶん〜でしょう: probably ~
- たぶん〜と{思|おも}う: I think probably ~
- たぶん〜だろう: probably ~ (casual)

CERTAINTY SCALE (low to high):
- もしかしたら: maybe, perhaps (~30%)
- たぶん: probably (~60-70%)
- おそらく: probably (formal, ~70%)
- きっと: surely, certainly (~80-90%)
- {絶対|ぜったい}に: absolutely, definitely (~100%)

USAGE:
Placed at the beginning of a sentence or before the verb/predicate. Very common in everyday speech.

KANJI:
{多分|たぶん} - the kanji literally means 'much/many portion.'
